Art salvaged from Laughter-Lust's (formerly TicklishTouch) DeviantArt before they killed it.

They retired DeviantArt after posting their "final pic" there in February 2024 on a high note. They suddenly returned in August 2025 for no reason.

Their artist profile
https://web.archive.org/web/20260602115324*/https://www.deviantart.com/laughter-lust/art/Artist-Profile-1233702959

After many Anti-AI rants and ONE Parasocial relationship addressing journal, they finally got fed up and left DA in June 10.

This is meant to be an archive since they have no intention to reupload their old old art anywhere. Just like every other artist who left actually. Which is very upsetting because I like his art style but I was tired of their Anti-AI tirades. And I don't intend to follow their FA and BlueSky.
